title: Stachybotrys Induced Hemorrhage in the Developing Lung
brief_summary: The majority of the workscope of this project is focussed on an infant animal model of toxigenic mold induced pulmonary hemorrhage. Clinically related studies are directed only to the description of human infants diagnosed with idiopathic pulmonary hemorrhage regarding their clinical parameters, and collecting samples of secretion, blood, and urine for analysis for fungal spores and mycotoxins. These latter analyses are being developed using the infant rat model.
raw_criteria: Inclusion: infant (\<12 mo old) with unexplained pulmonary hemorrhage, discharged home from newborn nursery Exclusion: hemorrhage occurred in hospital prior to going home prior to discharge from newborn nursery
